title: Big Bold Menthols Cherry Blackcurrant Menthol 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Big Bold Menthols Nic Salts Cherry Blackcurrant Menthol brings together the juicy, sweet taste of ripe cherries and the bold, tangy flavour of blackcurrants, perfectly balanced with a cool menthol finish. This refreshing and vibrant e-liquid offers a well-rounded, fruity vape experience with a crisp, cooling exhale, ideal for fans of fruit and menthol blends. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Big Bold Nic Salts are designed for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) starter kits and pod devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nic salts provide smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers looking for a fast, satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco products. If you love this flavour, there are several other flavours to try from Big Bold’s collection, including Menthols, Creamy and Fruity flavours. Explore such beguiling blends as Honey Melon, Banana Milk, and Vanilla Custard for a Big Bold burst of flavour and a taste sensation like no other.
